Asymptote and the libraries compiled into it

tex/vendor/asy/asy.wasm is Asymptote 3.09, built by tex/build_tools.sh from texlive-source at
f6b450440fca5d39f069f1d43153f7a8a75b04a1 (utils/asymptote, with the parts bundled there: GLEW,
TinyEXR, the PRC library, optional-lite), linked with GLM 1.0.1, Mesa 24.0.5 (OSMesa and softpipe),
GSL 2.8, FFTW 3.3.11, Eigen 3.4.0 and TeX Live's zlib, each from the archive SOURCES.md names.
Asymptote is under the GNU LGPL 3 or later; linked with GSL and FFTW, the program as built is under
the GNU GPL 3 or later. Emscripten's libraries in it: emscripten.txt.

The license texts these notices refer to that are not copied below (the GNU GPL, LGPL and
AGPL, the Mozilla Public License 2.0, the Apache License 2.0 and the Artistic License 2.0) are in
LICENSE and LICENSES/ and, in the built page, earlier in LICENSES.txt. SOURCES.md says where the
exact source of each part is. Apart from the headings and the lines that say what each part is
and what its license asks, everything below is copied from the file named under its heading;
comment markers are removed.

If you want to guarantee that the Eigen code that you are #including is licensed
under the MPL2 and possibly more permissive licenses (like BSD), #define this
preprocessor symbol:
  EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY
For example, with most compilers, you could add this to your project CXXFLAGS:
  -DEIGEN_MPL2_ONLY
This will cause a compilation error to be generated if you #include any code that is
LGPL licensed.

License and Copyright
=====================

Disclaimer
----------

Mesa implements various APIs, including `OpenGL`_, `OpenGL ES`_,
`Vulkan`_ and `OpenCL`_. Even though Mesa implements these APIs, the
implementation isn't formally conformant on all combinations of drivers
and hardware. `Khronos`_ maintains lists of conformant implementations
for each of their APIs, as well as `trademark details`_.

Please do not refer to the library as *MesaGL* (for legal reasons). It's
just *Mesa* or *The Mesa 3-D graphics library*.

.. _OpenGL: https://www.opengl.org/
.. _OpenGL ES: https://www.khronos.org/opengles/
.. _Vulkan: https://www.vulkan.org/
.. _OpenCL: https://www.khronos.org/opencl/
.. _Khronos: https://www.khronos.org/
.. _trademark details: https://www.khronos.org/legal/trademarks/

License / Copyright Information
-------------------------------

The Mesa distribution consists of several components. Different
copyrights and licenses apply to different components. For example, the
GLX client code uses the SGI Free Software License B, and some of the
Mesa device drivers are copyrighted by their authors. See below for a
list of Mesa's main components and the license for each.

The core Mesa library is licensed according to the terms of the MIT
license. This allows integration with the XFree86, X.Org and DRI
projects.

The default Mesa license is as follows:

  http://ridiculousfish.com/files/faster_unsigned_division_by_constants.pdf

The author, ridiculous_fish, wrote:

 ''Reference implementations of computing and using the "magic number"
   approach to dividing by constants, including codegen instructions.
   The unsigned division incorporates the "round down" optimization per
   ridiculous_fish.

   This is free and unencumbered software. Any copyright is dedicated
   to the Public Domain.''
